subsystem.name: VehicleAIPitControl
subsystem.responsibility: Per-frame AI driver control and pit-stop decision logic for race vehicles: AI tick orchestration (pre-race init vs racing path), waypoint/racing-line following, steering-target computation and lane scoring, driver-status state machine, AI ability drift, and tire-compound pit-stop scheduling with retirement.

summary: The vehicle AI subsystem drives one race vehicle per frame. AIMainUpdate (0x00424E70) is the tick orchestrator: it gates on aiEnableFlag, runs a pre-race/formation init branch and a racing branch, and commits control outputs into the vehicle input fields (0x3580/0x3584/0x357C). AIDriverStructInit (0x00424790) reinitialises the per-vehicle AI field block. The racing path delegates to AIWaypointSteeringUpdate (0x00426430), AIRacingLine (0x00425920), computeSteeringTarget (0x004270A0) and a driverStatus state machine (0..7) that dispatches SteeringAngleController (0x00425670) and related sub-functions. updateAIAbility (0x00429470) drifts the driver ability value and drives pit-stop decisions; PitStopDecisionTireCompound (0x0042A3D0) schedules tire compounds and can retire the vehicle. AISteeringRacingLineCorrection (0x0042B0E0) adjusts steering against the racing line. Two UNKNOWN-owner dispatch helpers (0x00409F40, 0x0040B360) perform chained vtable dispatch.

function_roles.role: Chained vtable dispatch helper: calls slot vtable+0x18 on this, then slot +0x1C on the non-null result and returns the second result, else the first.
Chained virtual dispatch helper: calls slot vtable+24 on this, then slot +28 on the non-null result, else returns the first result.

Per-frame AI driver subsystem reinitialization: clears AI state flags/timers/counters, seeds waypoint sentinels, resets pace/grip/pit/speed defaults, optionally reloads waypoint data and command-queue buffers.

Per-frame AI tick orchestrator: entry gate on AIEnableFlag, pre-race/formation init path, and racing path (heading vectors, driveability gate, lap-push, AIAbility refresh, pit entry/exit transitions, driverStatus 0..7 dispatch).
AI steering-angle and driver-status controller: follow-target steering (state 6) vs direction-vector steering, steering-error accumulator, position-snapshot timer toggling states 6/0.

AI racing-line and speed-profile update: waypoint chain resolution, lead-car aero drag, tire-force energy-decay speed profile, overtaking threat scoring, throttle/brake targets and overtaking-window flag.

AI waypoint-following and steering update: speed magnitude, waypoint re-query on drift, 20-node look-ahead chain rebuild, pit-lane entry command dispatch, tire-force grip solve, 0..3 speed zone, boundary-clamped steering targets.
AI steering-target computation: 5-lane boundary scan, centre steering, lane scoring via spatial queries, overtaking state transitions and session-time steering overrides.

Per-frame AI ability/driver tick: engagement-mode selection, difficulty scaling, per-frame ability drift and probability override, steering-target recompute, pit-stop decision logic (pit exit, tire-compound duration, fuel-weight pit exit).
Per-frame AI pit-stop logic: tire-compound selection vs lap count and session state, wing-repair lap records re-arm, vehicle retirement on blocking condition.
AI steering correction relative to the racing line: reference-opponent scan in race phase, wrapped-distance track parameter, overtaking/timing decisions and rotation-matrix steering recompute.

classes.name: F1CVehicle
classes.responsibility: Race vehicle: the AI field block (this base, roughly +0x4000..+0x461C) plus the shared vehicle fields (position, velocity, heading, gear, engine RPM, fuel, car conditions) that the AI tick reads and writes. The obj base is the vehicle root reached via this+0x0.

classes.name: WaypointNode
classes.responsibility: Waypoint-graph node reached through the vehicle pointer fields (0x4354 current, 0x4358 chain base, 0x4364 third chain node, 0x4400 lead reference, forward-link at +0x114). Holds position, tangent, up-vector, track distance, lateral boundaries, grip/traction, heading and node-id/pit-entry flag.

classes.name: RacingLineSteeringController
classes.responsibility: Per-frame AI steering-target computation: 5-lane boundary scan, centre-steering computation, lane scoring via spatial nearest-neighbour queries, and overtaking state transitions on the vehicle.

state_machines.name: DriverStatusMachine
transitions: pit-wait timer 0x4170 < now -> driverStatus = 4 (session type 0x7C56A4==7) else 5, then re-arm pit-exit timer 0x447C
0x447C snapshot timer -> toggle 6/0 and snapshot position into 0x4470/0x4474/0x4478
1 -> sub_4258C0; 2 -> FieldZeroSetter and return; 3 -> waypoint squared-distance vs 0x461C -> 0 when farther, else update 0x461C
steering-error accumulator 0x446C > 0x4558 -> driverStatus = 1 (after RaceStartCountdownStateUpdate when gear 0x39FC > 2)
racing-line reset path -> driverStatus = 4/5 by 0x7C56A4; pit-return 5 -> 3 after tier selection or -> 0

state_machines.name: PitStopDecisionMachine
transitions: PitStopBlockingCondition or session != 7 -> not service-ready; when session==7 set RetiredFlag 0x4410=1, clear AIControlFlag 0x45F4, log via sub_4BC060
service-ready path -> tire-compound tier selection and SpeedValueSetterWithGlobalMirror + PostPitCleanup

interfaces.name: SpatialWaypointQuery
interfaces.purpose: Nearest-neighbour, plane-test and indexed-field copy queries over the shared waypoint spatial tree (dword_5EA2C0) used by racing-line, waypoint-following and steering.

interfaces.name: AICommandQueue
interfaces.purpose: AI command-message queue: dispatch of pit-lane/waypoint-set commands (message id 14) and ring-buffer input selection for the AI tick.

compatibility_contracts.name: ControlOutputCommitContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Every AI tick path must write committed control outputs into the input fields this+0x3580 (throttle), this+0x3584 (brake), this+0x357C (steering) before returning; the racing fallthrough writes neutral (0, 1.0, 0). A replacement executable must preserve this commit location and neutrality.

compatibility_contracts.name: DriverStatusContract
compatibility_contracts.description: driverStatus at this+0x4510 must keep the documented 0..7 semantics: pit entry forces 4 or 5 (session type 0x7C56A4==7 selects 4), 6 is follow-target steering, 7 stops the car until Speed<0.2, and the racing-line reset forces 4/5 by the same session-type rule.

compatibility_contracts.name: AIEnableGateContract
compatibility_contracts.description: aiEnableFlag at this+0x32C8 gates the whole AI tick: AIMainUpdate returns immediately when >1, and the racing tick re-checks obj+0x32C8==1. A replacement must preserve both guards.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitLaneFlagContract
compatibility_contracts.description: PitLaneRouteFlag this+0x4548 and the pit-lane byte this+0x45F4 steer the pit-box/pit-lane steering overrides in computeSteeringTarget and gate the pre-race init path in AIMainUpdate; PitStopDecisionTireCompound sets 0x4548=1 on entry.

compatibility_contracts.name: WaypointTreeContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The waypoint spatial tree dword_5EA2C0 and its count/global neighbours (0x5EA2CC, 0x5EA2D0) back the nearest-neighbour queries; waypoint node id at +0x12C and the set selector this+0x4550 drive pit-lane command dispatch (message id 14).

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionPhaseContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Global session type dword_7C56A4 and phase dword_7C56A8 select the driver-status pit values, the countdown/launch ramp (dword_5C30E0 / dword_5C3144 tables, global byte_5C3160), the ability drift, and the retirement path; simulation time dbl_8AFEA0 is the shared clock for all timers.

compatibility_contracts.name: RetiredFlagContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Retirement sets RetiredFlag at this+0x4410 and clears AIControlFlag at this+0x45F4, then logs through sub_4BC060; AIDriverStructInit clears both when a session (re)starts.
